blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In trade, money is everything. We use different currencies. A currency is the money of a country. We use dollars (USD), pounds (GBP), euros (EUR), and reais (BRL).

Today you learn five words of money and how to say numbers. It is easy. We do it step by step. The price is four hundred dollars. Ten thousand tonnes is a big deal.

Sugar is sold in dollars. The London office works in pounds. Brazilian reais are our local currency. Numbers get easier with practice. Each new number is an open door.

items.q: What do we use different currencies for?
items.why: "In trade, money is everything." — usamos moedas para o comércio (trade).

items.q: What is a currency?
items.why: "A currency is the money of a country."

items.q: The London office works in…
items.why: "The London office works in pounds."

items.q: The text says "we do it step by step." This suggests the lesson is…
items.why: Inferência: "step by step" mostra que a lição é fácil e devagar.

items.q: "Each new number is an open door" suggests that learning numbers…
items.why: Inferência: "open door" (porta aberta) = nova oportunidade; aprender números ajuda.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan mostrando a lista de preços ao novo trader. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! I am Ethan. Let me show you this simple price list. It is very easy.

Look here. Sugar is four hundred dollars. We write USD for US dollars. The freight is fifty dollars. So the total is four hundred and fifty dollars.

In trade, we use different currencies. Here we use dollars. But the London office uses pounds. In Brazil, we use reais. The currency is the money of the country.

Now, numbers. Four hundred. Fifty. Ten thousand tonnes is a big deal for us. Two million is a very big amount. Say them with me, slow and clear.

Do not worry. Numbers get easier with practice. Each new number is an open door. We do it step by step, every day. You will be fine!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How much is the sugar?
items.why: "Sugar is four hundred dollars."

items.q: What is the total price?
items.why: "Sugar is four hundred… freight is fifty… total is four hundred and fifty dollars."

items.q: The London office uses…
items.why: "the London office uses pounds."

items.q: Ethan says "do not worry." This suggests he wants the new trader to feel…
items.why: Inferência: "do not worry" e "you will be fine" mostram que ele quer deixar a pessoa tranquila.

items.q: Why does Ethan say the numbers slow and clear?
options: To help the new trader learn
Because he is in a hurry
items.why: Inferência: falar devagar ("slow and clear", "step by step") é para ajudar o novo trader a aprender.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "In trade, money is everything." Money means…
items.why: Money = dinheiro.

items.q: "A currency is the money of a country." A currency is…
items.why: Currency = moeda de um país (dólar, libra, real...).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We use US ___ in trade."
items.why: Dollar = dólar; "We use US dollars in trade."

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The London office works in ___."
items.why: Pound = libra; a moeda usada em Londres.

items.q: "The amount is two million." Amount means…
items.why: Amount = quantia / valor (quanto de dinheiro).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de negócios com dinheiro. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Ten thousand tonnes is a big deal." A big deal means…
items.why: Big deal = algo importante ou grande.

items.q: "The boss must sign off on the price." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We work in dollars here." To work in dollars means to…
items.why: Work in (a currency) = usar aquela moeda no dia a dia.

items.q: "Money moves fast in trade." This means money…
items.why: Move fast = circula rápido, muda de mãos depressa.

items.q: "Let's add up the amount." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, chegar ao total.
